author: Marthijs-Berfelo
body:
## Lighthouse finding

Lighthouse accessibility audit (score: 79/100) reports that 4 buttons have no accessible name. Screen readers announce these as "button" with no context, making them unusable.

## Affected elements

- **Settings gear button** — `<IconButton>` in `src/common/toolbar/components/SettingsTools.tsx`, icon only, no `aria-label`
- **Print button** — `<IconButton>` in `src/common/toolbar/Toolbar.tsx`, icon only, no `aria-label`
- **Language selector button** — rendered by `react-flags-select` in `src/common/layout/components/LanguageSelector.tsx`
- **Chord / key selector collapsed buttons** — toolbar selector components

## Suggested fix

Add `aria-label` to each icon-only `<IconButton>`, sourced from the i18n translation files:

```tsx
<IconButton color="blue" aria-label={t('settings:gear.label')} className="mr-1">
  <FontAwesomeIcon icon={faGears} />
</IconButton>
```

Add the corresponding translation keys to `public/locales/en/settings.json` and `public/locales/nl/settings.json`.

## References

- [axe rule: button-name](https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.11/button-name)
- WCAG 2.1 Success Criterion 4.1.2 (Name, Role, Value)
title: a11y: icon-only buttons are missing accessible names
